handback.source_text: Launchpad (launched 2023) is a fiscally sponsored initiative of Building 21, a Philadelphia 501(c)(3) founded in 2013 (EIN 47-2514219), and plans to spin out as its own 501(c)(3). Site/hub: 801 Market Street, Center City, Philadelphia, PA 19107. Current applications are filed with Building 21 as the named applicant/fiscal sponsor and Launchpad as the sponsored initiative or solution (framing varies by funder — e.g. GSK: 'Building 21 primary, Launchpad initiative'; Truist: 'Building 21 applicant, Launchpad solution'). Still to confirm before applying: Launchpad's own registered legal name/EIN if/when spun out, and the fiscal-year start. Building 21 also operates two high schools (Philadelphia and Allentown), so it is a broader parent/fiscal entity than Launchpad alone.

results.answer: Launchpad builds accelerated pathways that connect Philadelphia young adults to high-paying, future-ready tech careers. Through a paid AI-engineering program grounded in real client work, participants who arrive with a high school diploma and little else gain applied AI skills, industry certifications, a portfolio of deployed work, and the paid experience employers now demand — at no cost to them — on a path toward a $50,000 living wage.

handback.instruction: Rewrite the source text below to fit 250 characters, following every rule.
handback.source_text: Launchpad recruits Philadelphia young people from more than 30 non-selective high schools and across 30+ ZIP codes, no prior experience required, and pays them from day one so finishing is financially possible. The advanced phases most funders support are LiftOff — six months of full-time, AI-first software-development training for participants 18–24 — and Launchpad Inc., a nonprofit social enterprise that puts participants on real, paid client projects ($20/hour) building automations, dashboards, integrations, and agents for Philadelphia nonprofits and small businesses. Participants train against the AI Engineer competency framework (six competencies, 24 skills; prompting and context engineering, building automations and agents, connecting systems, structuring data, evaluating AI output, and managing cost and risk), earn industry certifications (Generative AI Foundations, PCEP), and are assessed on deployed work tracked in Beacon, so every graduate finishes with a portfolio of shipped AI systems and the client references early-career tech hiring now screens on. Wraparound supports — a guaranteed $6,000 stipend floor, transportation, food, a laptop, and Career Success Coaching that continues through the first year of employment — remove the barriers that otherwise force low-income young adults to drop out. Delivered at no cost from Launchpad's Center City hub at 801 Market Street.

figure_work_order.policy: Live LP Internal AI connector figures supersede these knowledge-base figures by recency. Do not publish any figure below until the paired query_* call confirms it. On a drift conflict the connector wins. A DEFINITIONAL conflict is not auto-resolved — escalate it to staff with both numbers and their definitions. If a tool is denied by your role, write [DATA UNAVAILABLE] rather than quoting the frozen figure as if confirmed.

items.note: Prefer get_finance_brief — query_finances may be denied by the role ACL. If it is, flag [DATA UNAVAILABLE] rather than quoting the frozen figure as if confirmed.

The platform records a Lightspeed phase that the KB program descriptions omit entirely, so a drafted program description built only from the KB is missing a phase. Queried 2026-08-11 — Lightspeed is a 7-week summer intensive, run twice: 2024-07-01 to 2024-08-19 (7 completers) and 2025-07-07 to 2025-08-27 (8), 15 of 15 completing and none dropping. 14 of the 15 sat PCEP and all 14 passed. Do NOT describe it as a linear stage between 101 and LiftOff: it runs in the summer gap between school years, no student has it as current_phase, and its completers show up later under LiftOff and Alumni. Use query_enrollment active_during with phase=Lightspeed and a wide date window for the roster — by_phase gives only the counts, and by_student cannot filter by phase at all (see the filter caveat in CLAUDE.md §4).
Recompute from the connector; percentages move with each cohort.
The same aggregate call returns avg_hourly_wage and avg_weekly_hours.
